summary:
Independent fresh nonauthor source-attribution review of bounded packet part2 (requested model configuration Gemini 4 Argon High; actual runtime model identity not independently attested). Scope is strictly limited to the 12 selected claims (GR01, GR02, GR03, GR04, GR05, V01, V02, V03, V04, V05, V06, V07) out of the 61-claim parent table; the prior 18 part1 claims and remaining 31 claims in other parts are not reviewed or approved here.

All 12 in-scope claims and all 20 PATTERN-INVENTORY.json family entries were independently checked against the provided primary source payloads and enclosing definitions/callers:
1. GR01 (SOURCE_DECLARATION, Core1/Staged2 syntax, CORE-parser.rs:46-102, sha256 83c8d4fa...): Exact literal and line match inside parse_profile (lines 14-161). Faithfully attributes language quoted-profile header, agreement name and brace block, state name:type=literal; declaration, and asset identity block with fixed network, issuer, reference, scale order (u8 conversion on UInt literal) and optional trailing comma.
2. GR02 (SOURCE_DECLARATION, Core1/Staged2 syntax, CORE-parser.rs:103-151, sha256 83c8d4fa...): Exact literal and line match. Faithfully attributes action parenthesized typed inputs, brace-delimited statement list, pre-statement input name:type; declarations, per-action MAX_STATEMENTS (1024 in CORE-ir.rs:7) check, and total state+asset+action MAX_DECLARATIONS (256 in CORE-ir.rs:8) check.
3. GR03 (SOURCE_DECLARATION, Core1/Staged2 syntax, CORE-parser.rs:217-250, sha256 83c8d4fa...): Exact literal and line match. Faithfully attributes Parser::ty() recognizing UInt/Bool, Parser::literal() handling true/false or TokenKind::Number with underscore removal and u128 parsing, and Parser::push() refusing expression count >= MAX_EXPRESSIONS (8192 in CORE-ir.rs:6).
4. GR04 (SOURCE_DECLARATION, Core1/Staged2 syntax, CORE-parser.rs:252-305, sha256 83c8d4fa...): Exact literal and line match. Faithfully attributes Parser::expr() depth > 64 check, parentheses, unary not (precedence 6), literals, word names, liability_present/liability_amount with quoted duty string, and binary operator precedence branches (or=1, and=2, ==/not=/<=/ >=/</>=3, +/-=4, *=5) with enclosing loop continuation at lines 307-314.
5. GR05 (SOURCE_DECLARATION, Core1/Staged2 syntax, CORE-parser.rs:316-347, sha256 83c8d4fa...): Exact literal and line match. Faithfully attributes Parser::statement() branches for let, next, requires, ensures, emit, transfer, fee, liability, discharge, semicolon termination, and await label(binders) when expr gated on self.program.language == crate::stage::LANGUAGE_2.
6. V01 (SOURCE_DECLARATION, Core1, CORE-runtime.rs:120-152, sha256 7c736b2f...): Exact literal and line match. Faithfully attributes validate(program) checks for LANGUAGE/SEMANTICS identity, agreement identifier(&program.name), non-empty actions, MAX_DECLARATIONS/MAX_EXPRESSIONS bounds, and separate names() uniqueness passes over chained state+asset declarations and over action names (via names() at lines 39-50).
7. V02 (SOURCE_DECLARATION, Core1, CORE-runtime.rs:8-38 and 153-181, sha256 7c736b2f...): Exact literal and line match for both citations. Faithfully attributes identifier() (ASCII letter first byte, len <= 64, ASCII alphanumeric or '_', not in the 23-keyword/type/literal reserved list) and asset identity validation (non-empty <=1024-byte network/issuer/reference, scale <= 38, BTreeSet uniqueness, and no conflicting scale for equal network/issuer/reference triples).
8. V03 (SOURCE_DECLARATION, Core1, CORE-runtime.rs:182-232, sha256 7c736b2f...): Exact literal and line match. Faithfully attributes DAG expression reference check (usize::from(r) < i), derived depth <= 64, initial state value type matching state.ty, per-action input (<= MAX_DECLARATIONS = 256) and statement (<= MAX_STATEMENTS = 1024) bounds, input name validity/uniqueness via names(), and non-shadowing of state or asset declarations.
9. V04 (SOURCE_DECLARATION, Core1, CORE-runtime.rs:233-319, sha256 7c736b2f...): Exact literal and line match. Faithfully attributes ordered statement validation in validate(): Await rejection in Core1, Let typing via expr_type (lines 51-118) and non-shadowing check against identifier/env/assets, Bool predicates on Requires/Ensures, known state and matching type on Next, 1..=1024 byte string checks and expr_type/validate_asset/require_uint (lines 374-390) on Emit, Transfer, Fee, Liability, and Discharge.
10. V05 (CALL_EDGE, Core1/Staged2, CORE-runtime.rs:320-372 and CORE-stage-validate.rs:284-285): Exact literal and line match across both files. Faithfully attributes both validate and validate_v2 calling validate_liability_reads(program), and validate_liability_reads collecting LiabilityPresent/LiabilityAmount read names (1..=1024 bytes) and resolving them against Statement::Liability declarations across all actions for a single non-conflicting (asset identity, debtor, creditor) tuple.
11. V06 (SOURCE_DECLARATION, Staged2, CORE-stage-validate.rs:28-43 and 144-211, sha256 5828e182...): Exact literal and line match. Faithfully attributes identifier_v2/names_v2 reserving "await" and "when", and validate_v2 enforcing MAX_AWAITS_PER_ACTION (16), MAX_EVENT_BINDERS (16), MAX_CAPTURE_SLOTS (256) on captured count before a site, unique valid await labels per action, valid non-shadowing binders inserted into env before checking that guard has Type::Bool, and incrementing captured on Await binders and Let bindings.
